scope: Read-only exact version lookups of already instantiated entity/value MemberSet objects, including available own fields and observed base-pointer chains

derived_from.shared_abi_evidence: RTTI, member categories, option getters, registry traversal and string/vector ABI use the same declarations and checks documented in BridgeEvidence.json

primary_abi_sources.evidence: The intermediate RTTI classes add virtual functions but no data; single-inheritance RTTI adds one base-type pointer
RTTI base-pointer layout for a single public nonvirtual base at offset zero
Nonstatic method ABI supplies this as the first pointer argument

historical_lookup_evidence.address_basis: Static virtual addresses in the arm64 Mach-O slice; runtime code resolves exported symbols and never uses these offsets
historical_lookup_evidence.read_only_conclusion: Both exported const getters tail-call routines whose only stores preserve registers on the stack. The sole callee reads the current version. No allocation, initialization, insertion, migration, callback, or member-state mutation appears in either complete routine.
selection_semantics: UINT32_MAX or a request equal to MetaType::version selects the existing current MemberSet pointer, which can be null
Any other requested version searches the existing balanced tree by uint32 key; lower-bound traversal plus the final less-than-or-equal check requires equality
An empty tree or absent exact key returns null; no nearest-version fallback or historical schema synthesis occurs
A nonnull pointer can be uninitialized; initialized() is inspected before size() or member() access
The bridge issues numeric requests from zero through min(current_version, 128), inclusive; it never sends UINT32_MAX

base_chain_evidence.conclusion: base() returns only a MemberSet pointer. No historical version is returned. meta()->version() reports that metatype current version and cannot establish the historical version represented by the base pointer.
base_chain_evidence.output_policy: Only the directly requested own set receives lookup_version. Every inherited set has lookup_version null and version_resolution not_exposed_by_base_pointer; historical_base_profiles_verified remains false.

return_codes.0: Reflection captured and output successfully written
return_codes.1: Invalid output path or output I/O failure
return_codes.2: Loaded image or required symbol unavailable
return_codes.3: Main-thread, deployment, RTTI, or category guard failed
return_codes.4: Reflection bounds, text validity, or C++ exception failure

output_contract.file_mode: 0600, O_EXCL, O_NOFOLLOW; existing files are never replaced
output_contract.metatype_current_version: The current version returned directly by MetaType::version, separately recorded on each type and available set metatype
output_contract.member_set_lookups: For each entity/value, one record per numeric lookup_version from zero through min(metatype_current_version, 128), inclusive

lookup_status.absent: Getter returned null; member_sets is null
lookup_status.uninitialized: Existing own set is uninitialized; its members is null
lookup_status.initialized: Existing own set is initialized; its registered own fields are emitted

output_contract.lookup_limit_truncated: True for entity/value current versions above 128; higher versions, including current, were not queried by this bridge
output_contract.unsupported_categories: Member and other categories retain identity/category metadata but lookup_supported is false and member_set_lookups is null
output_contract.base_sets: Observed base-pointer chains are exported for inspection with unknown historical versions; they are not declared a proven historical inheritance profile
output_contract.members: Registration index, native member name, script id, debug type name, native member metatype identity/category, and raw option mask

retained_guards: Apple arm64, libc++ ABI namespace/layout and compile-time size checks
Fusion main thread required; caller must ensure a quiescent registry
Already loaded native images only via RTLD_NOLOAD and exact deployment path gate
Every required dlsym lookup checked before registry traversal
Validated native RTTI names, single inheritance representation, shared root identity and native dynamic cast
Registry, member, base-depth, string and output limits; base-pointer cycle detection
UTF-8 validation, unknown member-category rejection and bounded option mask extraction
New absolute output path only, exclusive creation, no symlink following, mode 0600
C++ exception reporting; no native signal recovery
limitations: Static exact-lookup behavior was followed by a successful native read-only capture; only instantiated versions were exposed
Historical sets are available only when instantiated in the active process; an absent entry does not prove the file version or schema never existed
Lookup version is the requested exact map key, not a field read from MemberSet; multiple version keys may alias one pointer
The valid registered type list omits invalid or unregistered types
The cap is maximum version value 128 inclusive, allowing at most 129 numeric lookups per supported type
A historical own-set entry does not prove the inherited historical profile; base pointers expose no version
No initializer, loader, document mutation, preference setter, Segment.Save or Segment.Load is called
The bridge does not establish custom serialization grammar, member wire order, primitive widths, option meanings, migration rules or complete file semantics
The caller must retain the original external native-image hash checks; the C++ code itself gates deployment path, not library content hash
The libc++ and RTTI ABI assumptions and native fault limitations documented in BridgeEvidence.json remain applicable
This is a native research oracle only; production Kit conversion must not depend on Fusion runtime
